items.title: 'Landfall' Malware Targeted Samsung Galaxy Users
items.description: The tool let its operators secretly record conversations, track device locations, capture photos, collect contacts, and perform other surveillance on compromised devices.

items.title: Malicious NuGet packages drop disruptive 'time bombs'
items.description: Several malicious packages on NuGet have sabotage payloads scheduled to activate in 2027 and 2028, targeting database implementations and Siemens S7 industrial control devices. [...]

items.title: 'Ransomvibing' Infests Visual Studio Extension Market
items.description: A published VS Code extension didn't hide the fact that it encrypts and exfiltrates data and also failed to remove obvious signs it was AI-generated.

items.title: Microsoft Backs Massive AI Push in UAE, Raising Security Concerns
items.description: In partnership with Emirates tech company G42, Microsoft is building the first stage of a 5-gigawatt US-UAE AI campus using Nvidia GPUs.

items.title: AI Security Agents Get Persona Makeovers
items.description: New synthetic security staffers promise to bring artificial intelligence comfortably into the security operations center, but they will require governance to protect security.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28159: Microsoft
items.description: A CVSS score 8.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Marcin Wiazowski' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-07, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-03-07 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28491: Microsoft
items.description: A CVSS score 3.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Jonathan Lein of Trend Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-07, 0 days ago.
